purpose.intro: Structural scaffolding for page composition. Every component here renders one `layout="..."` attribute and handles exactly one structural concern (scroll, overflow, collapse, sticky, width constraint). No visual CSS. No aesthetic opinions. The theme engine owns all visuals.

reference.statement: Full vocabulary, ownership rules, DOM examples, and the anatomy diagram: → `shared/libs/ui/docs/consumer/developer/layouts.md`

claims.text: A div renders either `layout` or `element` — never both.

These components emit zero visual CSS. No colors, no borders, no shadows. Tailwind structural classes only: `flex`, `overflow-hidden`, `sticky`, `min-h-0`, `w-full`, `grid` — structural behavior only.
Props exposed are structural only: `width`, `align`, `sticky`, `collapsed`. No `variant`, no `color`, no `emphasis`.
The theme engine reads `layout="..."` attributes and applies all visuals. Do not fight it.
Tailwind for structural classes only (flex, grid, overflow, positioning)
No CSS modules, no inline style objects for visual properties
No Radix, no headless UI — these are plain divs with layout logic
